title: Callout glyphs
description: Silhouettes for controls drawn outside the main art (triggers and bumpers), keyed by control id. Traced from the manual's top view by tools/pdfpaths.swift plus a flood-fill trace, rotated upright. Read by App.swift (Glyphs). File: data/callout-glyphs.json.

aspect.description: Height divided by width of the glyph's bounding box. The renderer sizes the frame from the width and this ratio.

paths.description: SVG-style path data normalised to a 0–1 box: tokens M, L, C, Z with space-separated coordinates. Solid glyphs hold one closed polygon.

solid.description: true when the glyph is a filled silhouette (one closed outline). false or absent means line art drawn as strokes over a capsule.
